column1: # E-D4-03's extra public captures (D4, P4-4-S2): the protocols of R6.7's
# insecure list and the platform's own sessions that MANIFEST.tsv and GT-PCAP
# do not hold. Wireshark's sample captures. Not vendored, as their
# redistribution terms are not stated; fetched at run time and checked.
# The SHA-256s are first-use pins: D4 downloaded each file on 2026-11-11.
# They carry no GT-PCAP label, so no pass condition reads them.
# No FTP capture: Wireshark's FTP samples are in Microsoft Network Monitor
# format, which libpcap does not read (rehearsal run 43080066361: Zeek
# "unknown file format" on FTPv6-1.cap, Suricata no output).
# No SNMPv3 capture: snmp_usm.pcap, the one SNMPv3 sample, is a big-endian
# BSD-loopback (link type 0) capture whose address-family word both pinned
# engines read as little-endian, so they drop every packet with no error
# (D6 on #630, from Zeek's Null.cc and Suricata's decode-null.c; in the
# rehearsal every configuration exited 0 with no flow). SNMPv3 is not shown.
